name: 50agents
description: What an AI agent can do with 50agents.com today: read what 50agents is and costs, find an app's page, and hand a person a link that opens Captain with their job already typed. Read-only; nothing here signs in or changes anyone's data.

skills.name: explain-50agents
skills.description: Answer what 50agents is: Captain builds apps, automations, AI agents and browser agents that work across 2,300+ apps through viaSocket. Read the home page in markdown.

skills.name: check-pricing
skills.description: Answer what 50agents costs: the free plan, the paid plans, what uses credits and top-ups. Read the pricing page in markdown.

skills.name: find-an-app
skills.description: Find what 50agents can do with one app: its triggers, actions and templates are on https://50agents.com/integrations/<app-slug>, and every indexed app and app pair is listed in the sitemaps.

skills.name: start-a-build
skills.description: Hand a person a link that opens Captain with their job typed in: https://50agents-app.embarko.app/login?draft=<the job in plain words, URL-encoded, up to 499 characters>. The draft is kept through sign-up or sign-in. The person signs in and taps Build it themselves; nothing is built until they do.
